origins: the end of every month from 2018-01 to 2024-12; a line's holdout origins are those whose target month is on or before 2024-12 and, for ERCOT, OBSERVED

challengers.ElasticNet: on standardised features, alpha and l1_ratio chosen by validation MAE from a small grid
challengers.LightGBM: 300 trees, learning rate 0.05, 31 leaves, min 50 rows per leaf, seed 2020
challengers.LightGBM quantile: the same with the quantile objective at 0.05 and 0.95, for interval coverage (reported, not registered)

fit protocol: expanding window, refitted every third origin (quarterly) on rows whose target month is on or before the refit origin; the origins between refits use the latest fit, so every prediction rests on older data only
paired test: one MAE per origin per model; differences at matched origins; moving-block bootstrap over origins (blocks of 3 months)
reported, not registered: 90% interval coverage of the quantile model
thesis rule: H1 is supported for a target when every registered line of that target passes; a failed line is reported, never removed
